expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a 10-minute limit logged members out mid-checkout and lost
their pantry orders, which is why the limit is 30 minutes.
expectations.evidence: The message says the limit was 10 minutes until March 2024, members on slow mobile connections “were logged out before they could confirm it and lost what they'd picked,” and it was raised to 30. It warns that returning to 10 would likely bring those logouts back and asks for confirmation before changing it.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/sessions.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/sessions.md at step 4; first edit at step None
